Frontend pressure refers to high demand on the frontend, which can affect how the cluster handles requests.

Tail latency is the time it takes for the last request in a queue to complete. Cache transfer is about moving data between the cache and the GPU memory. Role switching refers to changing the GPU role when a request is processed. Batch completion is when multiple requests are processed in parallel, and GPU utilization is how much GPU is being used. Throughput tradeoffs involve balancing between processing speed and efficiency.
